title: Kanokon Specials
justification: AniList 4760 (SPECIAL, 12 episode(s) from 2008-06-25) is AniDB 5575's special(s) S1-S12, aired 2008-06-25 to 2008-11-21. AniList's PARENT relation names the parent entry, which anime-offline-database links to AniDB 5575. The parent node has no mapping rows, so S1-S12 default to TVDB 0x1-0x12.
